style_concept: Clean light beach theme. Evokes warmth, approachability, and calm organization using an ocean and sandy color palette. Prioritizes touch-friendly elements, airy spacing, and high legibility for on-the-go property managers, cleaners, and vendors.

react_native_component_strategy.cards: Use View components with backgroundColor '#FFFFFF', borderRadius 12, borderWidth 1, borderColor '#E2E0D9'. Minimal elevation (elevation: 1, shadowOpacity: 0.05).
react_native_component_strategy.buttons: TouchableOpacity for primary actions with backgroundColor '#006D77', paddingVertical 14, borderRadius 8. Text should be Manrope SemiBold 16px.
react_native_component_strategy.inputs: TextInput wrapped in View with backgroundColor '#F5F2EA' or pure white with border. Height 48px for accessible touch targets.
react_native_component_strategy.checklists: Row views with minimum 48px height. Circular custom checkboxes. Use green_ready (#10B981) for completed state. Strikethrough text on completion.
react_native_component_strategy.kanban_board: Horizontal ScrollView wrapping vertical FlatLists. Columns have backgroundColor '#F5F2EA', borderRadius 12.
react_native_component_strategy.icons: lucide-react-native library. Use strokeWidth 2. Primary icon color matches text_primary or primary color.

properties.description: Sunlit living room with beach aesthetics

cleaning_maintenance.description: Pristine cleaning supplies for checklist or marketplace

testing_attributes.requirement: All touchable elements, inputs, list items, and key textual statuses must have a testID.

instructions_to_main_agent: This is an Expo React Native app. Do NOT build a React web app.
Write components in .js or .jsx files, not .tsx as requested by user.
Use standard React Native components: View, Text, TouchableOpacity, ScrollView, FlatList, TextInput.
Implement navigation using React Navigation (e.g. @react-navigation/bottom-tabs) for Dashboard, Turnovers, Maintenance, Messages, Settings.
Apply the defined Light Earthy/Beach theme colors. Ensure high contrast.
For icons, install and use lucide-react-native. Note: requires react-native-svg.
For the custom status colors, strictly use the hex codes provided in the colors.status object.
Build the Kanban board using a horizontal ScrollView containing vertical FlatLists for each column.
Implement the Cleaning Checklist using FlatList with custom interactive row components.
All interactive elements MUST have testID attributes following the kebab-case, role-based convention.
